question: Does a calibrated external late anchor (Qiu 2024, Theiler stage 23, ~E15) improve T1 over the frozen second-candidate latent flow?

external.source: Qiu et al. 2024 Nature 626:1084, CELLxGENE Census 2025-11-08
external.never_fetched: Theiler stages 14-22 (covers the excluded window after E9.5 through E13.5 with margin)

decision_rule: Pick at most one anchor candidate by development mean paired gain over 'flow'. Adopt only if, in BOTH confirmation runs, its mean paired gain over 'flow' is > +1.0 and no headline metric group drops by more than 1 point on average. Otherwise keep the second candidate unchanged.
caveat: E10.5 was already used in development of the second candidate; this is not a fresh biological holdout. The anchor fraction in the backtest (1/5.5) is smaller than for the real target (2/4.5).
